results.title: Boundless
results.overview: In a moment of cowardice, Detective Carl Mørck sends Rose, his junior colleague in Department Q, to the remote Danish island of Bornholm to answer his old colleague Christian Habersaat's repeated requests. But during his forced retirement ceremony Christian kills himself sending Rose into a journey deep into her own traumatic past. Later, Department Q are embroiled into an old cold case of a girl found dead hanging in a tree.

results.title: Still Stares
results.overview: Miguel is a renowned taxidermist and an expert hunter. He is always visited by clients seeking to naturalize pets and exotic animals. Through his work, Miguel will make us reflect on how we relate to other species.

results.title: Super/Man: The Christopher Reeve Story
results.overview: Christopher Reeve portrayed the Man of Steel in four Superman films and played dozens of other roles that displayed his talent and range as an actor, before being injured in a near-fatal horse-riding accident in 1995 that left him paralyzed from the neck down. After becoming a quadriplegic, he became a charismatic leader and activist in the quest to find a cure for spinal cord injuries, as well as a passionate advocate for disability rights and care.

results.title: The Last Gaucho
results.overview: An old gaucho in the countryside awaits his fate. Student short film.

results.title: Demolition 如常
results.overview: When an earnest couple was forced to leave their only home for an unspecified reason, their lives begin to shatter in pieces.

results.title: Breathe
results.overview: Air-supply is scarce in the near future, forcing a mother and daughter to fight for survival when two strangers arrive desperate for an oxygenated haven.

results.title: The Calendar Killer
results.overview: Klara is going to die today unless she kills her husband instead. The Calendar Killer has given her that impossible choice. When Jules starts his night shift at a telephone safety helpline for lonely women on their way home, Klara's call reaches him. He soon becomes her last hope for survival and races against time to save her.

results.title: Mai
results.overview: When a struggling single mother falls for a wealthy heartbreaker, their risky romance could just turn their lives around — or tear their worlds apart.

results.title: Amaran
results.overview: A heroic true story of Major Mukund Varadarajan, an Indian Army officer who displayed extraordinary bravery during a counterterrorism mission in Kashmir’s Shopian district. The film captures his courage in protecting his nation and the devotion of his wife Indhu Rebecaa Varghese.

results.title: Fuiste París
results.overview: Lena is in Paris on a scholarship to study the third year of her degree. Her dream had always been to live in that city, but as the weeks go by, her utopia fades away and she discovers a much more hostile place than she expected.

results.title: Insular
results.overview: The only survivor of an illegal boat trip bound for Puerto Rico struggles to survive in a deserted isle. As time passes, the castaway comes to believe the island is testing him by granting him what he needs if he chooses to stay.

results.title: A Fool's Love
results.overview: Kawai Joji, an aspiring screenwriter who has won a screenplay competition but has yet to make his professional debut, meets a beautiful woman, Naomi, in a rundown bar one day. Naomi says she is working at the bar while aiming to become an actress. On another day, Joji is asked by his screenplay instructor if he would like to write a screenplay for a film based on Tanizaki Junichiro's "A Fool's Love" on his behalf. Joji is determined to succeed this time, but struggles to write the script. Meanwhile, Joji meets Naomi again, and the two of them quickly become closer, but...

results.title: Baby Talk
results.overview: Elle is experiencing a pain all over her body and consults a medical professional for relief.

results.title: Ashes
results.overview: From an intoxicating fantasy to a dangerous affair, a wealthy married woman finds her life irreversibly shattered after picking up an unpublished novel.

results.title: Devolution
results.overview: A couple fights to survive in a post-apocalyptic world.

results.title: Prey
results.overview: A young couple is compelled to leave their Christian missionary station in the Kalahari Desert after being threatened with death by an extremist militant gang. After crashing their aircraft they must battle man and beast for their lives.

results.title: The Colors Within
results.overview: Totsuko is a high school student with the ability to see the 'colors' of others. Colors of bliss, excitement, and serenity, plus a color she treasures as her favorite. Kimi, a classmate at her school, gives off the most beautiful color of all. Although she doesn't play an instrument, Totsuko forms a band with Kimi and Rui, a quiet music enthusiast they meet at a used bookstore in a far corner of town. As they practice at an old church on a remote island, music brings them together, forming friendships and stirring affections.

results.title: Parallel Lives
results.overview: The lives of two seemingly unrelated people struggling with mental illness become eerily intertwined.

results.title: Yolo
results.overview: After an argument with her younger sister, Le Ying moves out on her own. She meets a boxing trainer and starts boxing.

results.title: Doraemon the Movie: Nobita's Earth Symphony
results.original_title: 映画ドラえもん のび太の地球交響楽
results.overview: When a malevolent entity intent on eradicating music from the world surfaces, Nobita and his friends must unite with supernatural companions to safeguard the planet.
